entries.a799abc0367fe734: It is a single segment covering retail sales of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, miscellaneous goods, food and other products. The core subsidiary Genki Co., Ltd. operates the drugstore “Genky”, offering a wide range of daily necessities under the concept of “a store where you can save on living costs nearby.” As of June 20, 2026, it operates a total of 534 stores in Fukui, Ishikawa, Gifu, Aichi and Shiga prefectures, consisting of 506 standardized 300-tsubo R stores and 28 large-format stores. Revenue by store format was ¥197,228 million for R stores, ¥23,113 million for large-format stores and ¥297 million for others. Genki Shokuhin Co., Ltd. handles food manufacturing, Genki Fudosan Co., Ltd. handles store development and Genki Logistics Co., Ltd. handles logistics, and together they support store operations across the group.
